summary: Script code is well-written (type hints, error handling, clear logic), and workflow YAML structure is sound. Critical failures: (1) Zero test files provided—TDD requirement completely unaddressed; conftest.py is just a docstring, no tests exist. (2) Fixture files missing: workflow references fixtures/keep_n.json, fixtures/age.json, etc., none provided—workflow will fail on first run. (3) No act-result.txt generated (required artifact). (4) Workflow will error immediately with FileNotFoundError. The agent delivered a script but abandoned the TDD methodology and testing harness entirely, making the deliverable non-functional as specified.
